answer: Influence should follow a receding tide of peer flow, not a headcount of keys. Each epoch, only attestations from distinct established peers since the last close count; a farm of fresh aliases is left dry when that tide goes out, because last-epoch seals do not carry forward. The node also publishes an atlas binding every accepted work trace to one vault and nonce sequence, so a copied résumé cannot mint a second voting identity. Burned, clustered, or early-withdrawn keys are poured into basalt: the stake is not inherited, and a replacement identity posts a new bond with zero stacked weight.
